features: Wireless Plug & Play: With Key2 Combo wireless keyboard & mouse set, get to typing quicker with the USB plug-and-play setup that'll have you connecting to your PC faster and easier than ever.
Quiet & Comfortable Keystrokes: The scissor-style switches allow you to experience noiseless typing comfort like never before and reduces typing fatigue.
Ambidextrous Mouse: Designed to be used by left- and right-handed users, enjoy responsive and smooth mouse performance with optical tracking of 1200 DPI.
Compact Design: The tenkeyless keyboard is designed to be easy-to-carry & travel-friendly i.e. this is not a full-layout keyboard and is without the 10-key numeric pad.
Durable Build: With long life of over 10 million keystrokes for the keyboard and 3 million clicks for the mouse, this keyboard and mouse set is durable and delivers optimal work quality to you.
